revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready. Claytor suggests elevating Benaissa's ἀπελεύθερος to the text. I have encoded slightly differently to allow accreditation to Benaissa. Claytor also notes that what the scribe wrote in lin4 is not ναμήσεται but ναμήσετε. He is certainly correct that the ending αι was not written. I make the following observations. After the tau the scribe may have started to write a pi, realising the mistake a small epsilon was at first squeezed in between the vertical of the tau and the first vertical of the pi. Thereafter a large epsilon was written over the pi. In a further act of correction the epsilon may have been retraced with a less generous round stroke which crosses through horizontal stroke. I decided not to try to encode this as a scribal correction. In the future a better explanation may be found.

Submit - Added corrections according to Ferretti, in Pylon 5, 2024. At l. 11, I added a proposed regularisation of the original edition, marked as uncertain because the original editor did not propose any regularisation for this irregular verbal form
